key_insight: The paper argues that the orchestration/control layer of agentic AI systems should follow Bayesian decision principles: using posterior beliefs and expected-utility calculations to choose tools, experts, and actions under uncertainty leads to principled, calibrated decisions.
problem_solved: How to make agentic AI reliably decide which tool or action to take when faced with uncertainty; current heuristic or ad-hoc orchestration lacks principled uncertainty representation and decision rules.
method: Position and formalize Bayes-consistency as a design principle for the orchestration/control layer of agentic systems (posterior + expected utility drives choices).
Recommend mechanisms: probabilistic models or calibrated posteriors for beliefs, Bayesian updating from observations, and utility-aware decision rules to select tools/actions.
Provide practical guidance for modular orchestration: expose uncertainty to downstream components, encode priors/constraints, and evaluate via calibration and decision-theoretic metrics.
impact: Adopting Bayes-consistent orchestration can make LLM-based agents more reliable, interpretable, and resource-efficient by aligning action selection with quantified uncertainty and expected outcomes. This gives practitioners a clear, testable framework for safer and better-calibrated agent design.
visual_elements: Agent architecture diagram showing separate layers: perception/LLM, probabilistic belief updater (posterior), decision module (expected-utility), and tool executors.
Decision flowchart: posterior distribution → expected-utility calculation → tool/action selection, with examples of alternative choices.
Calibration/uncertainty plot comparing heuristic vs Bayes-consistent orchestration (prediction confidence vs accuracy) and a bar chart of expected utility/resource use.
Icon set: posterior (probability curve), utility/value (scale), tool selector (gear icons), and calibration gauge.
paper_title: Position: agentic AI orchestration should be Bayes-consistent
paper_authors: Theodore Papamarkou, Pierre Alquier, Matthias Bauer, Wray Buntine, Andrew Davison
